frontier_act_119.text: Congress must answer the urgent call for immediate action on AI regulation, and leaving Washington without addressing this matter would be reckless and irresponsible. It's clear there is great risk in the continued development of super intelligence with no guardrails, and Speaker Johnson and the President refuse to act responsibly and decisively. I have recently championed the bipartisan FRONTIER Act, one of several bills I've supported that merit debate and a vote on the House floor.
